Package com.agui.json.mixins

Interface ResumeMixin

public interface ResumeMixin
Jackson mixin interface for configuring JSON serialization of Resume objects.

Resume is a simple record (interruptId, status, payload), so no polymorphic type discrimination is required. This mixin only pins the property order so the emitted JSON consistently mirrors the AG-UI wire format: 


 {
   "interruptId": "int-1",
   "status": "resolved",
   "payload": { "confirmed": true }
 }

The status field (ResumeStatus) relies on the shared EnumWithValueMixin (registered separately) to serialize as its lowercase wire value (e.g. "resolved", "cancelled") rather than its Java enum name.
